title: Meta's AI Coding Agent Muse Code Challenges OpenAI and Anthropic
description: Meta has introduced an AI coding agent named Muse Code, positioning itself to compete with existing AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic.

sections.heading: Meta's AI Coding Agent
paragraphs: Meta has debuted its first AI coding agent, Muse Code, as reported by CNBC. This move is seen as Meta's attempt to enter the AI coding market and compete with companies like OpenAI and Anthropic.

sections.heading: AI Coding Market
paragraphs: According to Seeking Alpha, Meta is looking to take on OpenAI and Anthropic with the release of Muse Code. This indicates a growing interest in AI coding solutions and the competitive landscape within the industry.

sections.heading: AI Developer Assistant
paragraphs: Social Media Today reports that Meta has made AI Developer Assistant its primary support option. This suggests that Meta is integrating AI more deeply into its services and support systems.

faq.a: Meta's AI coding agent is called Muse Code.

faq.a: Meta is looking to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic in the AI coding market.

faq.a: Meta has made AI Developer Assistant its primary support option.
